notes: «أن ابن شهاب أخبره» makes Zuhri a link (rule 5); Urwa speaks inside the story about Umar's late prayer and then relays the Prophet, so Urwa's own chain runs to Abu Mas'ud
Abu Dawud's remark that Ma'mar, Malik, Ibn Uyayna and others narrated the Zuhri version without the time is a variant group; the further variants («هشام بن عروة وحبيب») are left out
